Definition: Identifier of the included synthesis, usually first author and year. Use the recorded identifier for joins; do not infer publication year from it. The final Total row has a blank study_id and must be excluded from study-level analysis.
DOI of the included synthesis, as recorded. A URL or placeholder can occur when a DOI is unavailable; trim whitespace when matching.
PlumX page for the synthesis; -- or --- indicate an unavailable identifier/link.
Whether PlumX recorded policy citations. Total identifies the final summary row, which is not a synthesis.
Open-access categories retained from the bibliometric record; blank means no label recorded.
Policy-citation count captured on 9 July 2025, before the later extraction and within-synthesis deduplication.
Date on which the policy records for that synthesis were extracted.
Policy-citation count on the recorded extraction date, before within-synthesis deduplication.
Retained policy-citation count after deduplication within each synthesis. This is not a count of globally distinct policy documents across syntheses.
Extraction and deduplication notes supporting the counts.
